plan.summary: A Plan gets its document: Participants open a Thread on a Block, reply, and resolve it into a Decision that stays attached to the Block. plan.title: The plan, written in an editor: comments that end in decisions, live
plan.author: pratos with Claude Code
plan.summary: A Plan gets its text and its comments. Participants write it in a Tiptap editor, where "/" opens a block menu and every save is an EditPlan event, refused when based on an older edit. They open a Thread on a Block and resolve it into a Decision. Every tab sees each change at once through the PlanRoom's hibernating sockets. Resolving ships behind `resolve-thread`.
plan.current: cp-04 has accounts and sign-in, the Flags service with `resolve-thread` seeded off but allowlisted for admin and pratos, admin pages and Playwright. There is no Plan yet. No Durable Object, thread commands, event log per Plan or page at `/plans/:id`.
discoveries: The PlanRoom appends a command's events in one synchronous block, so `ThreadResolved` and `DecisionRecorded` land together or not at all.
Flags cross into the Durable Object as a list of names; a function would arrive as an RPC stub whose promise reads as true.
Thread commands carry `by` in the body (`CommandEnvelope`); the page's *acting as* field sets it, starting as `pratos`.
`docs/DOMAIN-VOCABULARY.md` has no `ThreadClosed` and bans *verdict*, so the vocabulary check catches the first pass by name alone.
The upcaster is a pure function tested on a verbatim v1 stream; `PlanRoom.read()` does not call it yet.

plan.title: The plan, written in an editor: comments that end in decisions, live
plan.author: pratos with Claude Code
plan.summary: A Plan gets its text and its comments. People write it in a Tiptap editor ("/" opens a block menu); every save is an EditPlan event. Selected text becomes a Thread that resolves into a Decision. Each plan is its own room; the API keeps the list.
plan.current: cp-04 has accounts and sign-in, the Flags service with `resolve-thread` seeded off but allowlisted for admin and pratos, admin pages and Playwright. There is no Plan yet. No Durable Object, thread commands, event log per Plan or page at `/plans/:id`.
discoveries: The PlanRoom appends a command's events in one synchronous block, so `ThreadResolved` and `DecisionRecorded` land together or not at all.
Flags cross into the Durable Object as a list of names; a function would arrive as an RPC stub whose promise reads as true.
Thread commands carry `by` in the body (`CommandEnvelope`); the page's *acting as* field sets it, starting as `pratos`.
`docs/DOMAIN-VOCABULARY.md` has no `ThreadClosed` and bans *verdict*, so the vocabulary check catches the first pass by name alone.
The upcaster is a pure function tested on a verbatim v1 stream; `PlanRoom.read()` does not call it yet.
plan.endState: Home opens or starts a plan. Two tabs on `/plans/gh-12`: text written in one appears in the other, and so does a Thread; resolving it shows who decided. Calling the event `ThreadClosed` fails `just domain-vocabulary-check`.
notDoing: Hiding Resolve without the flag; until the release stage the page shows the refusal.
Reopening a Thread or editing a Decision; a change of mind is a new Thread.
Sessions and the agent; they arrive at cp-06.
Wiring the upcaster into `read()`; this stage proves the rung on a recorded stream.
Checking a thread command's `by` against the sign-in; sessions do that from cp-06.
plan.approach: Domain first, because event shapes are the contract the room, page and tests read. Then the room and its API behind the flag, then the live page, then the checks that catch a wrong name.
